dogecoin.text: @MeekMill @elonmusk join the Shiba party! Once Dogecoin hits $1 you have done everything you can for it. Shiba is ERC-20 and has much better support by its founders (Shiba Swap, Bone, Leash, etc).

@dogecoin_devs @dogecoin I think we have done all we can for Dogecoin-it will likely head to $1 at some point but now we should focus on Shiba Inu Coin. Their team is quietly building a better product and set to release a new exchange called Shiba Swap.

@elonmusk what if the real irony surrounding crypto is that a coin (Shiba Inu) inspired by the coin setup to be a joke (Dogecoin) is actually the coin that has the most utility? With Shibaswap on the way it will be the coin that Doge could never be via ERC-20, staking, governance

@GeneralShibarmy Yes, I did the same a few months ago after asking myself the following: Without a complete overhaul Dogecoin has it already peaked? If it has not peaked what is it’s potential for growth and what does that look like from a numbers standpoint? For myself, the reward wasn’t enough.
@SephMoJo @dogecoin_devs @dogecoin It will eventually become an ERC-20 token and be trade able on Shibaswap—which would be great since they both can represent man’s love for dogs.
